evidence.title: Firewall logs from all 14 sites reach the syslog server over site VPNs that end on the Transit Gateway. The VPNs only carry routes for 10.40.0.0/16.
evidence.How we know: Read the Transit Gateway route tables in the network account and matched them against the VPN module in the network Terraform. Both show the site VPNs advertising only 10.40.0.0/16. The network team confirmed it's current.
Gathered from: AWS account: prod-network · Transit Gateway route tables
Infrastructure as code: infra-network repo · VPN module

evidence.title: Firewall logs average 1.2 TB a month. Transit Gateway charges $0.02 per GB it processes, about $24 a month at this volume.
evidence.How we know: Datadog's usage page for the last 90 days, priced with AWS's published Transit Gateway rates.

evidence.title: Shared Tooling's private subnets have 212 free addresses across three zones.
evidence.How we know: Listed the Shared Tooling subnets in the tooling account and added up their available addresses.

evidence.title: Datadog sizes workers at 2 vCPU per 10,000 events a second. Our peak is 18,000, so three workers still cover it with one zone down.
evidence.How we know: Datadog's sizing guidance for Observability Pipelines Workers, applied to our busiest hour over the last 30 days.
Gathered from: Vendor documentation: Datadog OPW sizing guide
Datadog: Log volume, peak hour, last 30 days

evidence.title: The syslog server is one instance in one zone. It dropped messages during restarts twice this year.
evidence.How we know: The instance's placement in the tooling account, and two incident reviews that traced missing firewall logs to syslog restarts.

evidence.title: A PrivateLink endpoint service can sit in any VPC; customers connect to it without routes into our network.
evidence.How we know: AWS's PrivateLink documentation for endpoint services.
Gathered from: Vendor documentation: AWS PrivateLink, endpoint services

evidence.title: At us-gov-west-1 list prices, a Transit Gateway attachment is about $36 a month, a Network Load Balancer about $16 plus usage, a c7g.large about $53, and S3 Standard storage about $0.027 per GB.
evidence.How we know: AWS's published on-demand prices for GovCloud (US-West).
Gathered from: AWS pricing: GovCloud: EC2, Elastic Load Balancing, Transit Gateway, S3

evidence.title: An S3 bucket policy can be at most 20 KB. In the format our other buckets use, that fits about 60 per-customer statements.
evidence.How we know: The bucket policy size limit in AWS's S3 documentation, and the size of one per-customer statement in the policy used by the existing export bucket.
Gathered from: Vendor documentation: Amazon S3 bucket policies, limits
AWS account: shared-tooling · export bucket policy

evidence.title: S3 has FIPS endpoints in GovCloud (US-West), and AWS KMS keys there are held in FIPS 140-validated hardware security modules.
evidence.How we know: AWS's FIPS endpoint list for GovCloud and the AWS KMS documentation on its hardware security modules.
Gathered from: Vendor documentation: AWS GovCloud (US) FIPS endpoints
Vendor documentation: AWS KMS, cryptographic details
